tokens.name: palette-n0
tokens.usage: Neutral 0, the lowest surface of the theme. Only `bg` should point here.

tokens.name: palette-n1
tokens.usage: Neutral 1, one step above the canvas. Only `panel` points here.

tokens.name: palette-n2
tokens.usage: Neutral 2, floating-layer surface. Only `overlay` points here.

tokens.name: palette-n3
tokens.usage: Neutral 3, hairline strength. Only `border` points here.

tokens.name: palette-n7
tokens.usage: Neutral 7, secondary text. Only `fg-muted` points here.

tokens.name: palette-n9
tokens.usage: Neutral 9, primary text. Only `fg` points here.

tokens.name: palette-red
tokens.usage: Red hue anchor of the theme, text-safe (4.5:1). Source of `danger` and, in A-share projects, of `up`.

tokens.name: palette-green
tokens.usage: Green hue anchor of the theme, text-safe (4.5:1). Source of `success` and, by default, of `up`.

tokens.name: palette-amber
tokens.usage: Amber hue anchor. Source of `warning` only.

tokens.name: palette-blue
tokens.usage: Blue hue anchor. Source of fleet-ade's brand accent.

tokens.name: palette-cyan
tokens.usage: Cyan hue anchor. Source of `info`.

tokens.name: brand-fleet
tokens.usage: Project layer, fleet-ade: the accent of the product. Default project.

tokens.name: brand-trade
tokens.usage: Project layer, trading review app (`data-project="trade"`): indigo accent. Not red or green, which belong to market direction.

tokens.name: brand-board
tokens.usage: Project layer, fleet dashboard (`data-project="board"`): teal accent.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Main canvas: chat area, dialogs' inner fields, inputs. Text on it: `fg`, `fg-muted`, `accent`, `danger`.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Sidebar, detail panel, table header, chip and tag fill, status strip. Text on it: `fg`, `fg-muted`, `accent`, `danger`.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: menu, select popover, command palette, hover card, tooltip, toast, dialog. Always with `border` and `shadow-overlay`. Text on it: `fg`, `fg-muted`.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body and control text on `bg`, `panel`, `overlay`, `selected`, `hover`.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, timestamps, icons that are not the point. Holds 4.5:1 on `bg`, `panel`, `overlay`, `selected`, `hover`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and 1px outlines of inputs, cards, tables, popovers. Decorative; never the only signal of state.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary button fill, links, active mark, focus ring. Also usable as text on `bg`/`panel`/`overlay` (4.5:1). Never for status.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill. Equal to `bg` of the same theme.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Mark only (dot, icon, thin bar): running, connected, succeeded. 3:1 on `bg`/`panel`/`overlay`. The label next to it is `fg`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Amber. Reserved for two things: spending money and deleting something that cannot be recovered. Never for "not logged in", "paused", "interrupted" or "attention". Mark only, 3:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, interrupted or failed runs, destructive buttons. Usable as text (4.5:1) and as a fill under `on-danger`.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `danger` fill. Equal to `bg` of the same theme.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and "needs you" marks, including not logged in. Mark only, 3:1.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Neutral wash (fg at about 9-12%) behind the selected row, active menu item, current thread, active command-palette row. Never tinted by the brand, so all three projects share it. `fg` and `fg-muted` hold 4.5:1 on it over `bg`, `panel` and `overlay`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer behind a drawer or modal on phones. Never carries text.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Translucent fg wash laid over any surface on hover; two layers on press. Never replaces `selected`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px, offset 2px. Same hue as `accent`; 3:1 on `bg`/`panel`.

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: Market direction: price or value rose. Default = `palette-green`; `data-project="trade"` switches it to `palette-red` (A-share convention). Always paired with ▲ and a plus sign. Not `success`.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Market direction: price or value fell. Default = `palette-red`; `data-project="trade"` switches it to `palette-green`. Always paired with ▼ and a minus sign. Not `danger`.

tokens.name: flat
tokens.usage: Market direction: unchanged, or no data. Same as `fg-muted`, shown as an en dash.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1 (blue family). Only for legend dots, segmented bars and chart marks; never for text, controls or state, never the only carrier of meaning. 3:1 on `bg`/`panel`/`overlay`. Adjacent segments keep a 1px gap; the brand accent is not a series colour.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2 (orange family). Only for legend dots, segmented bars and chart marks; never for text, controls or state, never the only carrier of meaning. 3:1 on `bg`/`panel`/`overlay`. Adjacent segments keep a 1px gap; the brand accent is not a series colour.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3 (green family). Only for legend dots, segmented bars and chart marks; never for text, controls or state, never the only carrier of meaning. 3:1 on `bg`/`panel`/`overlay`. Adjacent segments keep a 1px gap; the brand accent is not a series colour.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4 (purple family). Only for legend dots, segmented bars and chart marks; never for text, controls or state, never the only carrier of meaning. 3:1 on `bg`/`panel`/`overlay`. Adjacent segments keep a 1px gap; the brand accent is not a series colour.

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Categorical series 5 (yellow family). Only for legend dots, segmented bars and chart marks; never for text, controls or state, never the only carrier of meaning. 3:1 on `bg`/`panel`/`overlay`. Adjacent segments keep a 1px gap; the brand accent is not a series colour.

tokens.name: data-6
tokens.usage: Categorical series 6 (pink family). Only for legend dots, segmented bars and chart marks; never for text, controls or state, never the only carrier of meaning. 3:1 on `bg`/`panel`/`overlay`. Adjacent segments keep a 1px gap; the brand accent is not a series colour.

families.sans: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei UI", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Cascadia Mono", "Liberation Mono", ui-monospace, monospace

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper lines, thread second line, table headers (weight 500 variant).
styles.sample: 上一轮中断了，打开会话点继续

styles.name: caption-strong
styles.usage: Group labels in menus and the command palette (a block title). Not for tags or counts, which are 400.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Sidebar rows and read thread titles, menu items, inputs, field labels, table cells, pickers. The minimum size for anything clickable.

styles.name: control-strong
styles.usage: Button text, block titles (panel section heads), unread thread titles, the selected nav item. The only places weight 500 appears.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Message text and the composer. Line height is 1.6.
styles.sample: 我读了 3 个文件，改了 2 处。

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, empty-state headings, settings section titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Page titles. The largest size in the product.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, paths, branch names, diff lines.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Code at 12: tool output blocks, a path, branch or ID inside a meta line. Not for numbers: counts, sizes, money, percentages and times are sans with tabular-nums (`.fa-num`), right-aligned in columns.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside tags, gap between stacked strips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and chips; padding inside compact controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and button horizontal padding; row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between sections in a column.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks on a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Largest gap; page top padding.

tokens.name: space-row-x
tokens.usage: Density: left/right padding of a list row inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-row-x-menu
tokens.usage: Density: left/right padding of an item inside a floating layer (menu, palette, select).

tokens.name: space-row-y
tokens.usage: Density: top/bottom padding of a two-line row (= 2px transparent seam + 6px padding).

tokens.name: space-row-seam
tokens.usage: Density: transparent band at the top and bottom of every clickable row, so adjacent hover/selected fills never touch (4px gap between two fills).

tokens.name: space-icon-gap
tokens.usage: Density: 16px icon or agent slot to the row text.

tokens.name: space-trail-gap
tokens.usage: Density: minimum gap from row text to the value, time or buttons on the right.

tokens.name: space-list-inset
tokens.usage: Density: outer margin between a panel edge and its list rows, so a hover fill never touches the container edge.

tokens.name: space-sec-y
tokens.usage: Density: space above a section head and below its last row; the hairline sits between two sections (text-to-line about 18px, as measured).

tokens.name: space-demo
tokens.usage: Density: gap between stacked demo blocks and page blocks; caption to its demo is at least 12.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, kbd, menu items, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, thread rows, strips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers, dialogs, composer, panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and the thin meter only. Not a fourth step for controls.

shadow.note: One tier, for floating layers only. Panels, rows and buttons carry no shadow; they use a 1px border.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menu, popover, command palette, hover card, tooltip, toast, dialog, drawer.

size.note: Control and row heights, all multiples of 4. Density follows the measured rhythm of mainstream desktop developer tools: clickable one-line rows 32, data-only rows 24, two-line rows 52, section heads 32.

tokens.name: ctrl-2xs
tokens.usage: Category tags, count badges, kbd keycaps. Never a click target on its own.

tokens.name: ctrl-xs
tokens.usage: Removable chips, segmented-control items, icon buttons inside rows.

tokens.name: ctrl-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, icon buttons in rows, detail rows in panels.

tokens.name: ctrl
tokens.usage: Default button, input, select, menu item, panel section head.

tokens.name: ctrl-lg
tokens.usage: Large button, status strip, toast, touch targets on phones.

tokens.name: row-1
tokens.usage: One-line list row, the default for long lists (最近, 工作区): agent slot + title + time. Also the details-panel row: icon + 14px label + value.

tokens.name: row-2
tokens.usage: Two-line row (ChangeRow, 等你处理 thread rows, expanded TaskRow, menu items with a description): 8 + 14/20 title + 12/16 second line + 8. Measured pitch in mainstream desktop developer tools is 50.

tokens.name: bp-composer-foot
tokens.usage: Breakpoint (container width): below it the composer footer variant keeps only the agent slot of the model picker and folds effort + permission mode into a ⋯ menu.

tokens.name: bp-composer-account
tokens.usage: Breakpoint (container width): below it the standard composer drops "· 本机账号" from the model picker.

tokens.name: bp-composer-icon
tokens.usage: Breakpoint (container width): below it the standard composer model picker shows only the agent slot and chevron.

tokens.name: bp-batch
tokens.usage: Breakpoint (container width): below it the thread batch bar keeps 已选 N 项 + 归档 and folds 移到分组 / 删除 into ⋯.

tokens.name: row-data
tokens.usage: Data-only row that is not clickable: context breakdown lines, items inside an expanded group. Anything clickable is at least row-1 (32).

tokens.name: row-3
tokens.usage: Three-line result row (command palette): 2 seam + 8 + 20 title + 16 summary + 16 meta + 8 + 2 seam.

tokens.name: row-table
tokens.usage: Table body row (`.fa-table td`): 40, a spec of its own. A table row carries several aligned columns of numbers that are read across, so it gets more height than a list row (row-1, 32). The header row stays ctrl (32). Not used outside tables.

tokens.name: bw-1
tokens.usage: Every border and divider.

tokens.name: bw-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring thickness.

duration.note: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses all of these to reducedMotion; tokens.css carries that rule, so every transition that takes its duration from a token follows.
